title.description: The app's name, over its pages.

description.description: What the app is for, for those who build it.

id.description: Names the page in the app's address and in an action that opens it.

title.description: The page's name in the menu and over its sheet or modal.

kind.description: A page in the menu, or one that opens on a record: a record page, a side sheet or a modal.

record.description: The table whose row a record page, side sheet or modal opens on.

help.description: A topic of the workspace's documentation, shown by the page's Help button.

size.description: For a side sheet or a modal: how big it opens.

icon.description: The icon beside the page in the app's menu, by its name in the kit's set.

id.description: Names the widget on its page: what an action and a filter point at.

type.description: The widget, by its pack and name, as core/chart.

title.description: The heading drawn on the widget. Left out, it has none.

x.description: The column it starts at, from 0.

y.description: The row it starts at, from 0.

w.description: How many columns wide it is.

h.description: How many rows tall it is.

at.description: Where it sits on the page's grid of twelve columns, and its size.

data.description: What the widget reads, by the name of each input its definition declares, read on the server as the reader may.

oneOf.description: A visual query.

visual.description: A query made by choosing a table, what to keep, how to group and what to work out.

joins.description: Reference columns of the table to follow, to read the columns of what they point to.

filters.description: What to keep: a row stays when all of them hold.

value.description: What it is compared with. Left out for `is_null` and `not_null`. For `last`, a count and a unit; for `between`, two dates.

groupBy.description: What to break the values down by.

bucket.description: For a date or a time: how long each group is.

measures.description: The values to work out for each group.

fn.description: How the value is worked out.

column.description: The column it is worked out of. A count of rows has none.

as.description: What the value is called in the result.

columns.description: For rows with nothing worked out: the columns to read. Left out, all of them.

sort.description: The order of the result, the first sort being the main one.

by.description: A column, or the name of a value worked out.

limit.description: At most this many rows of the result.

query.description: A saved query, by its path.

values.description: What its parameters are given, by name.

sql.description: One SELECT, on a dashboard, with $1, $2 as parameters.

record.description: The record the page was opened on.

selected.description: The row chosen in a table or list of the page, by that widget's id.

own.description: The current user's own row of a table.

by.description: The column that holds the user's email.

approvals.description: The approval steps of the workspace's flows that wait for a decision, for a member who may read them.

flows.description: The flows, by path. Left out: every flow with an approval step.

whose.description: `mine` lists only those the viewer may decide; `all` every one they may read.

source.description: What it reads: a table from menus, a saved query, SQL on a dashboard, or the page's record.

filters.description: The page's filters that narrow it, each by the column it narrows or the parameter it fills.

filter.description: The filter, by its name, as a Search and filter widget on the page declares it.

column.description: For a table read from menus: the column the filter narrows.

columns.description: For a search over a table read from menus: the columns it looks in. A row is kept when any holds the words.

parameter.description: For a saved query or SQL: the parameter the filter fills.

part.description: For a range of dates filling a query: whether this parameter is its first day or its last.

config.description: The widget's settings, checked against its definition's schema.

on.description: What happens when the widget raises an event (a row clicked, a point clicked): an action, by the event's name.

additionalProperties.description: What happens when someone acts on a widget.

text.description: More under the question. It may name a column of the record as `{column}`.

button.description: What the button that goes on says.

ask.description: Fields the confirmation asks for before the steps run, such as a reason.

name.description: What the answer is called, for a step to use as `{ asked: name }`.

type.description: What kind of answer it takes.

required.description: Whether the action waits for an answer.

steps.description: What it does, in order. Steps that change data or start work run on the server first, and the ones that move the reader run in the browser after.

oneOf.description: Sets fields of a record to named values. The fields named are all it may change.

record.description: The record to change. `this` is the record the page was opened on, and `event` is the one the event gave: the row clicked, or the row whose action was pressed.

set.description: What to set, by column name.

additionalProperties.description: A value a step sets or passes. It is never an expression: it is one of these kinds.

oneOf.description: A constant.

value.description: The value itself: text, a number, true or false.

oneOf.description: The date the step runs, in UTC.
The moment the step runs, in UTC.
Who is acting.
A column of a record.

of.description: Which record: `this`, the one the page was opened on, or `event`, the one the event gave. Left out, `this`.

oneOf.description: What the person typed in the confirmation.

asked.description: The `name` of the field the confirmation asked for.

oneOf.description: Adds a row to a table, with the fields named.

set.description: The row's fields, by column name.

additionalProperties.description: A value a step sets or passes. It is never an expression: it is one of these kinds.

oneOf.description: A constant.

value.description: The value itself: text, a number, true or false.

oneOf.description: The date the step runs, in UTC.

of.description: Which record: `this`, the one the page was opened on, or `event`, the one the event gave. Left out, `this`.

asked.description: The `name` of the field the confirmation asked for.

oneOf.description: Removes a record.

record.description: The record to remove. `this` is the record the page was opened on, and `event` is the one the event gave: the row clicked, or the row whose action was pressed.

oneOf.description: Starts a flow that has a manual start.

input.description: What the flow is given, by the name of each input.

additionalProperties.description: A value a step sets or passes. It is never an expression: it is one of these kinds.

oneOf.description: A constant.

value.description: The value itself: text, a number, true or false.

oneOf.description: The date the step runs, in UTC.

of.description: Which record: `this`, the one the page was opened on, or `event`, the one the event gave. Left out, `this`.

asked.description: The `name` of the field the confirmation asked for.

oneOf.description: Starts a script.

input.description: What the script is given, by the name of each input.

additionalProperties.description: A value a step sets or passes. It is never an expression: it is one of these kinds.

oneOf.description: A constant.

value.description: The value itself: text, a number, true or false.

oneOf.description: The date the step runs, in UTC.

of.description: Which record: `this`, the one the page was opened on, or `event`, the one the event gave. Left out, `this`.

oneOf.description: What the person typed in the confirmation.

asked.description: The `name` of the field the confirmation asked for.

oneOf.description: Opens a page of this interface. A record page, a side sheet or a modal is opened on a record.

record.description: The record the page is opened on. `this` is the record the page was opened on, and `event` is the one the event gave: the row clicked, or the row whose action was pressed.

oneOf.description: Closes the side sheet or modal this page is open in.
Says something in a notice.
Sets a page filter to what the event gave: the group of a point clicked narrows the page to it.

filter.description: The name of the page filter.

from.description: The part of what the event gave that the filter is set to.

oneOf.description: Shows the rows behind what was clicked, in a side sheet. It only reads.

when.description: When it may be pressed: all must hold, for the record it acts on. They are checked again on the server.

items.description: A sentence that is true or not, about a record or about who is looking.

oneOf.description: A column of a record, tested.

of.description: Which record: `this`, the one the page was opened on, or `event`, the one the event gave. Left out, `this`.

value.description: What the column is tested against. Not given for `is_empty` or `is_not_empty`.

oneOf.description: Who is acting.

group.description: The group the current user must be in, by its path.

oneOf.description: Whether a record is there.

record.description: Whether a record must be chosen.

of.description: Which record: `this`, the one the page was opened on, or `event`, the one the event gave. Left out, `this`.

done.description: What is said when it worked, if the steps say nothing themselves.

runBy.description: Who may run it. Left out, whoever may open the app may. With groups named, only their members may, which the server checks, and a call to the API too.

groups.description: The groups, each by its path: an end-user group or a member group.

rules.description: When the widget is shown. Hiding a widget isn't security: the rows a person gets are decided by the tables' row rules.

showWhen.description: The widget is shown only while all of these hold.

items.description: A sentence that is true or not, about a record or about who is looking.

oneOf.description: A column of a record, tested.

of.description: Which record: `this`, the one the page was opened on, or `event`, the one the event gave. Left out, `this`.

value.description: What the column is tested against. Not given for `is_empty` or `is_not_empty`.

oneOf.description: Who is acting.

group.description: The group the current user must be in, by its path.

oneOf.description: Whether a record is there.

record.description: Whether a record must be chosen.

of.description: Which record: `this`, the one the page was opened on, or `event`, the one the event gave. Left out, `this`.

seenBy.description: Shown only to members of these groups. Drawing only: hiding a widget is not security.

groups.description: The groups, each by its path.

layout.description: How it is placed on smaller screens: tablet and phone made from the desktop or placed by hand, what narrow screens do with it, and its priority when the page stacks.

tablet.description: Placed by hand on a tablet. Left out, its place is made from the desktop's.

x.description: The column it starts at, from 0.

y.description: The row it starts at, from 0.

w.description: How many columns wide it is.

h.description: How many rows tall it is.

phone.description: Placed by hand on a phone. Left out, its place is made from the desktop's.

x.description: The column it starts at, from 0.

y.description: The row it starts at, from 0.

w.description: How many columns wide it is.

h.description: How many rows tall it is.

narrow.description: On narrow screens: keep its share of the row, take the full width, be stacked below the rest, or be hidden. Left out, it is automatic.

priority.description: When the page stacks, what is higher is kept nearer the top.

in.description: The Section, or the tab of Tabs, the widget is placed in. Its place is then on that container's own grid.

tab.description: For Tabs: the tab it is on, by its id.

pages.description: The app's pages, in the order of its menu.
